title: Gate construction for disjunctive normal form
statement: For a Boolean function $f\colon (\mathrm{Fin}\,n\to\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\})\to\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$, define its gate output to be the pair obtained by emitting AND trees from the minterm leaves of the satisfying assignments of $f$, initialized with the input negation gates, and then emitting an OR tree from the resulting roots. The pair consists of the resulting gate list and its output vertex.
caveat: The supplied statement refers to the constructions `satList`, `mintermLeaves`, `negInputGates`, `emitTrees`, and `emitTree` without defining them, so their precise gate construction and output-vertex conventions are unavailable.
